body.statement: The unique minimizer of \(\Phi_k(d)\) over \(d\in\mathcal D_L\) is \(d^\star=u\mathbf 1_p\), where \(u=\min\{L/p,1/2\}\), and \[\Phi^\star=\sum_{j=0}^{k}\binom pj r(u)^j.\] Moreover, every \(d\in\mathcal D_L\) satisfies \[\Phi_k(d)-\Phi^\star\ge 8C_{p,k}\|d-d^\star\|_2^2.\] The coefficient \(8C_{p,k}\) is the best global strong-convexity certificate when \(L\ge p/2\).
body.justification: This is the exact design choice and a quantitative certificate of the loss from dosage imbalance.
body.gap: ShyamalZhangUhler2025 proves the limited-supply closed form only for \(k=1\); SchwabeWong1999 does not impose or optimize the shared expected-supply simplex.
body.consumer: An independent-delivery interaction screen can set all dosages to \(u\) and quantify the population precision penalty of implementation error.
